data.narrative:
Pyka is a Series B-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 8 private peers in the sector, including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation; no public comparables exist in this subsector. The company has raised $40M to date.

Given data constraints, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using $40M in total capital raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement yields $76M. This reflects empirical progression patterns between funding stages in frontier-tech hardware. The peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Drones & Autonomous universe—only one same-stage peer was identified, below the three-datapoint threshold needed for reliable median calibration.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $65M to $87M, with a central estimate of $76M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the stage-progression multiplier for autonomous hardware specifically, the absence of recent comparables at similar valuation tiers, and limited visibility into customer traction or production metrics. A follow-on Series B round or disclosure of material revenue/partnership milestones would narrow this range materially.
